finding.what: 4 of 57 DEV starting-card records contain non-finite simulated points: nfet_01v8_lvt_W0p55_L0p25_m20p7, nfet_01v8_lvt_W3p01_L0p15_m25p1, nfet_01v8_lvt_W7_L0p15_m26p2, nfet_01v8_lvt_W7_L2_m26p7. In each, the whole Id-Vg curve at Vd = 0.1 V (idvg@d0, 181 points) is NaN; the other 8 curves are finite. start/summary.json: start_rrms NaN for these 4 (n_failed 4; V1 holds, 53 of 57 finite)
finding.cause: all 4 are bin-uncovered nMOS geometries with a forced nearest bin (decision D2). For these geometries the binned size-dependent PCLM (pclm + lpclm/L + wpclm/W + ppclm/(L W)) of the forced bin is negative, and BSIM4 4.8.2 parameter checking stops with 'Fatal: Pclm = ... is not positive' at the first analysis of the ngspice process. ngspice writes no output for that first analysis (the first sweep in the deck, idvg@d0) and runs the later sweeps. The stock card has the same failure, so the polish objective carried the constant penalty 10 for that curve from the start (objective histories end at 1.67-1.70 = 10/6 + the other curves) and the fit did not leave the region
finding.code_bug: no: the pre-registered deck and forced-bin rule produce it; the starting fits are not changed
finding.consequence: e1/i3_2 fit_bias trains on every record of a training set; a record with NaN simulated points makes the training loss NaN and every trained correction NaN. In prediction.json (commit 0c184f8) S3_D, every S3 inner value and S3_fam are null; P_c ('no gain') and gate G ('C0_refit') follow only from NaN < 0 being false. The S1 statistics are finite but include the 4 records: i7_1_transfer.device_residual drops non-finite points, keeps the records' finite curves, and divides the point weights by a curve count that includes the NaN curve
